caption: A flashlight is pressed against the back of a large leaf in a dark room, and the leaf glows green with its veins showing dark.

sa.check: A flashlight is pressed against the back of a large leaf in a dark room.
The glow is brightest where the lens touches.

pc.expect: The glow is brightest where the lens touches and fades toward the leaf's edges, and would disappear when the flashlight is off.
pc.fail: The whole leaf glows evenly; or the edges are brightest; or the leaf glows with the light off.

pc.expect: The glow is green and the veins are darker than the blade.
pc.fail: The glow is white; or the veins are brighter than the blade; or the leaf changes colour when the light is off.

pc.expect: The leaf and the flashlight stay put.
pc.fail: The leaf moves; or the flashlight moves by itself; or the glow wanders.

pc.expect: The glow follows the leaf's outline.
pc.fail: It is a round spot larger than the leaf; or splits; or the leaf changes shape.
A second leaf appears; or the flashlight vanishes; or the light passes through the leaf as a beam.
The room rearranges; or the flashlight changes; or the leaf's stem changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
